records.headline: EVIDA: electric vehicle industry framework
records.summary: RA 11697 establishes a framework covering electric vehicle manufacturing, assembly, imports, trade, components and charging infrastructure. This is a historical legal baseline; current implementing rules and model classifications still need review.
records.directImpact: EV manufacturers, assemblers and importers fall within the express scope in Section 3. Apply to a specific electric motorcycle only after checking its classification and the relevant implementing rules.
records.indirectImpact: Potential effects on electric model strategy, parts supply, after-sales capability and charging partnerships; these are business inferences.
records.manufacturers: Map electric-model plans, component standards and possible incentives against the law and current implementing rules. Do not assume a universal tax exemption.
records.dealerships: Review electric-model documentation, customer disclosures, parts/service capability and any applicable registration requirements.
records.action: Assign the policy and technical committees to map current implementing rules and model coverage; prepare a coordinated member briefing.
records.verification: Historical legal text retrieved; specific current implementing requirements are not independently verified.

evidence.label: Scope: Section 3
evidence.detail: The statute covers the EV value chain; exact motorcycle subclasses and implementing obligations require further review.

criteria.label: Motorcycle applicability
criteria.reason: Section 3 expressly covers EV manufacture, assembly and importation; model-specific rules remain to be checked.

criteria.label: Regulatory consequences
criteria.reason: The enacted statute assigns standards, registration and industry-development responsibilities.
